title: Noise2Void
paper_title: Noise2Void - Learning Denoising From Single Noisy Images
core_mech: Noise2Void 通过输入操纵构造 blind spot，只从单张 noisy 图像回归其被隐藏中心，而非需要成对噪声或 clean target。
core_mech_en: Implements practical single-image blind-spot denoising by randomly masking center pixels via neighborhood replacement so a standard U-Net predicts held-out pixels.
input_desc: 一张噪声图像；训练时随机选取中心像素并用邻域值替换
input_en: Single noisy image (with random center pixels replaced by neighboring values during training)
output_desc: 每个像素的条件期望估计形成的去噪图像
output_en: Denoised image estimate x̂ from a single forward pass

adapter.name: Noise2Void
adapter.mechanism: Neighbourhood replacement removes selected central observations from the input; only those held-out targets contribute to loss.
limitations: Randomized regular partitions ensure no selected pixel leaks through another replacement; smaller U-Net and modified mask sampling.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
